provenance.source: real-host test round 4 (r4e4c-6, r4e4c-8, r4e4g-7, r4e4g-8): common typos left as typed, a trailing emoji and one non-English word blocking fixes
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: Authored typos that SCOWL lists only at level 95 (its misspellings) or the 1934 dictionary keeps were dropped as real words.

steps.type: accomodate the enviroment untill succesful and refered

draft.text: accommodate the environment until successful and referred

cases.note: An emoji after a word separates it like one before it (`recieve🔥` stayed while `🔥recieve` was fixed).
One Cyrillic word leaves the English words on the line correctable.
One accented word is a loanword or a name, not a foreign line.
The same for a Spanish title before English words.
Control: two accented words make the line German, and its ASCII words stay as typed.
Control: a Japanese run on the line keeps its ASCII words as typed.
